== Story 636: primary-source comparison ==
[[Media:Decipher Glossary Supplement.pdf|Decipher Glossary Supplement (updated 29 January 2002)]], PDF p. 4. Emperor Palpatine becomes Emperor. Braces around leader and capitalization/italics/bold/punctuation variation are document presentation, not additional PC states; preserve the verbatim witness separately. Verbatim Supplement witness: <nowiki>Deploy on an Imperial of ability < 5 present with Vader, Emperor or one of your admirals, generals, or moffs. Imperial gains {leader} skill, is power +1, and is immune to Demotion, Report to Lord Vader, and What is Thy Bidding, My Master?. (Immune to Alter).</nowiki> The comparison uses the printed full-face capitalization and renders leader without undefined braces. [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Players Committee, SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A (edition dated 30 July 2023)]], PDF p. 112. and Supplement PDF11 describe presentation differences; no additional words-only PC state is invented. Original printed face: [[:File:Dagobah-D-fieldpromotion-decipher-archive.gif]].
